A.claim: Kernel-checked first factorisation step for signature (p,p,r), p odd prime: A^p+B^p = (A+B)*S with S = sum A^i(-B)^{p-1-i}, S = p*A^{p-1} mod (A+B), and for coprime A,B every common divisor of A+B and S divides p; hence in a counterexample (A+B)*S = C^r with gcd | p.
